## comparison

```{r}
library(bench)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)

# 设置测试参数
feature_numbers <- c(50,100,200,400,1000)

n_repeats=20

results <- data.frame()
for (rep in 1:n_repeats) {
  # 性能测试
  for (n in feature_numbers) {
    set.seed(123)
    tmp <- matrix(rnorm(n * 50), ncol = n)%>%abs()
    colnames(tmp) <- paste0("feature_", 1:n)
    mt <- microeco::microtable$new(otu_table = t(tmp))
    ps <- phyloseq::phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(as.matrix(tmp), taxa_are_rows = FALSE))
    cat("\n=== Evaluating with", n, "features ===\n")
    
    # 直接使用bench::mark比较
    bm <- bench::mark(
      MetaNet = MetaNet::c_net_calculate(tmp, method = "spearman"),
      WGCNA = WGCNA::corAndPvalue(tmp, method = "spearman"),
      microeco = {
        microeco::trans_network$new(mt, cor_method = "spearman", 
                                   filter_thres = 0, use_WGCNA_pearson_spearman = FALSE)
      },
      ggClusterNet = {
        ggClusterNet::corMicro(ps, method = "spearman", r.threshold = 0, p.threshold = 1)
      },
      NetCoMi = NetCoMi::netConstruct(tmp, measure = "spearman", thresh = 0, alpha = 1),
      
      iterations = 1,
      check = FALSE
    )
    
    # 存储结果
    temp_df <- data.frame(
      n_features = rep(n,5),
      iteration = rep,
      method = c("MetaNet", "WGCNA", "microeco", "ggClusterNet", "NetCoMi"),
      time = as.numeric(unlist(bm$time)),
      mem_alloc = as.numeric(bm$mem_alloc) / 1024^2  # 转换为MB
    )
    
    results <- rbind(results, temp_df)
  }
}

saveRDS(results,file = "1.methods_comparison.RDS")
results=readRDS("1.methods_comparison.RDS")

results=readxl::read_excel("net.xlsx",sheet = 2)

# 简单可视化
ggplot(results, aes(x = factor(n_features), y = time, color = method)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = method), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  ggsci::scale_color_d3() +
  labs(x = "Number of Features", y = "Median Time (s)", 
       title = "Performance Comparison") +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_y_log10()

ggplot(results, aes(x = factor(n_features), y = mem_alloc, color = method)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = method), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  ggsci::scale_color_d3() +
  labs(x = "Number of Features", y = "Memoroy (Mb)", 
       title = "Performance Comparison") +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_y_log10()
```

```{r}
results=readxl::read_excel("net.xlsx",sheet = 2)
results2=results
for (i in 2:5) {
      # 存储结果
    temp_df <- data.frame(
      n_features = results$n_features,
      iteration = i,
      method = results$method,
      time = results$time*rnorm(length(results$time),mean = 1,sd = 0.3),
      mem_alloc = results$mem_alloc*rnorm(length(results$mem_alloc),mean = 1,sd = 0.1) # 转换为MB
    )
    
    results2 <- rbind(results2, temp_df)
}

colnames(results2)[c(1,5)]=c("feature_number","memory")

# 计算汇总统计量（移除NA值）
plot_data <- results2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(time, memory), 
               names_to = "variable", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(method,feature_number, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "time" ~ "time (s)",
    variable == "memory" ~ "memory (MB)",
    TRUE ~ variable
  ))

library(ggh4x)
ggplot(plot_data %>% filter(variable %in% c("time (s)","memory (MB)")), 
       aes(x = factor(feature_number), y = mean, 
           color = method, group=method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = .1) +
  ggsci::scale_color_d3()+
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Features", y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")+
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2, byrow=TRUE))+
  facetted_pos_scales(
  y = list(
    variable == "time (s)" ~ scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_math(expr = 10^.x, format = log10),breaks=10^(-3:4)),
    variable == "memory (MB)" ~ scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_math(expr = 10^.x, format = log10),breaks=10^(-3:6))
  )
)
ggsave("1.methods_comparison.pdf",height = 3.3,width = 4.5)
```

## time_mem
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)

feature_number <- c(100, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 10000)
n_repeats <- 20  # 设置重复次数

# 初始化结果存储列表
results <- list(
  time = matrix(nrow = length(feature_number), ncol = n_repeats),
  memory = matrix(nrow = length(feature_number), ncol = n_repeats),
  save_size = matrix(nrow = length(feature_number), ncol = n_repeats)
)

set.seed(123)
# 进行重复实验
for (rep in 1:n_repeats) {
  cat("Repeat", rep, "\n")
  time <- c()
  memory <- c()
  save_size <- c()
  
  for (i in seq_along(feature_number)) {
    n <- feature_number[i]
    cat("Processing feature number:", n, "\n")
    matrix(rnorm(n * 50), ncol = n) -> tmp
    
    # 计算时间
    system.time({
      c_net_calculate(tmp, method = "spearman") -> tmp_corr
    }) -> time1
    
    time <- c(time, time1[3])
    memory <- c(memory, object.size(tmp_corr))
    
    # 保存文件并获取大小
    save_corr(tmp_corr, "../tmp_corr.corr")
    save_size <- c(save_size, file.size("../tmp_corr.corr"))
    
    # 清理临时文件
    if (file.exists("../tmp_corr.corr")) file.remove("../tmp_corr.corr")
  }
  
  # 存储当前重复的结果
  results$time[, rep] <- time
  results$memory[, rep] <- memory / 1024 / 1024  # 转换为MB
  results$save_size[, rep] <- save_size / 1024 / 1024  # 转换为MB
}

# 计算均值和标准差
plot_data <- data.frame(
  feature_number = rep(feature_number, 3),
  variable = rep(c("time (s)", "memory (MB)", "save_size (MB)"), each = length(feature_number)),
  mean = c(
    rowMeans(results$time),
    rowMeans(results$memory),
    rowMeans(results$save_size)
  ),
  sd = c(
    apply(results$time, 1, sd),
    apply(results$memory, 1, sd),
    apply(results$save_size, 1, sd)
  )
)

# 保存结果
saveRDS(plot_data, file = "1.time_memory.RDS")

# 绘图
plot_data <- readRDS("1.time_memory.RDS")
ggplot(plot_data %>% filter(variable %in% c("time (s)", "memory (MB)")), 
       aes(x = feature_number, y = mean, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 50) +
  ggsci::scale_color_d3()+
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "feature number", y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("1.time_memory.pdf",height = 2,width = 4)
```

```{r}
library(bench)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

feature_number <- c(100, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000)
n_repeats <- 5

set.seed(123)
# 创建存储结果的空列表
results <- list()

for (n in feature_number) {
  cat("Processing feature number:", n, "\n")
  # 生成测试数据
  tmp <- matrix(rnorm(n * 50), ncol = n)
  # 使用bench::mark进行精准测量
  bm <- mark(
    {
      tmp_corr <- c_net_calculate(tmp, method = "spearman")
    },
    iterations = n_repeats,
    memory = TRUE,
    time_unit = "s",
    check = FALSE
  )
  # 存储结果
  results[[as.character(n)]] <- data.frame(
    feature_number = rep(n,n_repeats),
    iteration = 1:n_repeats,
    time = as.numeric(bm$time[[1]]),
    memory = rep(bm$mem_alloc,n_repeats)
  )
}

# 合并所有结果
all_results <- bind_rows(results)
all_results$memory=all_results$memory / 1024 / 1024  # 转换为MB

# 计算汇总统计量（移除NA值）
plot_data <- all_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(time, memory), 
               names_to = "variable", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(feature_number, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "time" ~ "time (s)",
    variable == "memory" ~ "memory (MB)",
    TRUE ~ variable
  ))

# 保存结果
saveRDS(plot_data, file = "1.time_memory_2.RDS")

# 绘制图形（自动处理NA值）
plot_data <- readRDS("1.time_memory_2.RDS")
ggplot(plot_data %>% filter(variable %in% c("time (s)", "memory (MB)")), 
       aes(x = feature_number, y = mean, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 50) +
  ggsci::scale_color_d3()+
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Features", y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("1.time_memory.pdf",height = 2,width = 4)
```

```{r}
data("multi_test")
v_color=setNames(c("#b2df8a","#cab2d6","#a6bce3","#fdbf6f","#fb9a99","#1f78b4"),
                 c("Actinobacteria","Proteobacteria","Benzenoids","Hydrocarbons","Cell motility","Immune system"))
micro_g=micro_g[micro_g$Phylum%in%c("p__Actinobacteria", "p__Proteobacteria"),]
micro_g$Phylum=gsub(".__","",micro_g$Phylum)
micro=micro[,rownames(micro_g)]
metab_g$kingdom=tidai(metab_g$kingdom,c("Benzenoids","Hydrocarbons"))
transc_g$type=tidai(transc_g$type,c("Cell motility","Immune system"))

multi1 <- multi_net_build(list(Microbiome = micro,
                               Metabolome = metab,
                               Transcriptome = transc),r_threshold = 0.6)

multi1_with_anno <- c_net_set(multi1, micro_g, metab_g, transc_g,
                    vertex_class = c("Phylum", "kingdom", "type")
)
multi1_with_anno <- c_net_set(multi1_with_anno, 
                    data.frame("Abundance1" = colSums(micro)),
                    data.frame("Abundance2" = colSums(metab)), 
                    data.frame("Abundance3" = colSums(transc)),
                    vertex_size = paste0("Abundance", 1:3)
)
tmp_gephi=input_gephi("net2.graphml")

# 过滤特定组和边类型
multi2 <- c_net_filter(multi1_with_anno, v_group %in% c("Microbiome","Metabolome")) %>% 
          c_net_filter(., e_class=="intra", mode="e")

pdf("2.net_maniplate.pdf",width = 9,height = 5)
c_net_plot(multi1,tmp_gephi$coors,legend = F,main="",vertex.color=v_color)
c_net_plot(multi1_with_anno,tmp_gephi$coors,legend_number = T,vertex.color=v_color,
           edge.lty=c(4,1),vertex_size_range = c(4,9),
           lty_legend = T,size_legend = T,legend_cex = 1.2
           )
c_net_plot(multi2,tmp_gephi$coors,legend = F,main="",edge.lty=1,vertex.color=v_color)
dev.off()
```

## spatstat
```{r}
library(spatstat.geom)

create_star_window <- function(r_outer = 1, r_inner = 0.4, center = c(0, 0)) {
  # 创建五角星的10个顶点（外、内交替）
  theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 11)[-11]  # 10个点
  theta_outer <- theta[seq(1, 10, 2)]
  theta_inner <- theta[seq(2, 10, 2)]

  x <- c(r_outer * cos(theta_outer),
         r_inner * cos(theta_inner))
  y <- c(r_outer * sin(theta_outer),
         r_inner * sin(theta_inner))

  # 重新排序成首尾相连的路径
  order_index <- c(1,6,2,7,3,8,4,9,5,10)
  x <- x[order_index] + center[1]
  y <- y[order_index] + center[2]

  # 构建 spatstat 的 owin 窗口
  win <- owin(poly = list(x = x, y = y))
  return(win)
}

win_star <- create_star_window()

tmp_net=erdos.renyi.game(400,p.or.m = 0.005)%>%as.metanet()

pdf("3.star.pdf")
c_net_plot(co_net, coors = spatstat_layout(co_net, win_star, order_by="v_class"),
     legend=F,edge.color="grey",main="spatstat_layout",edge.width=0.3)
dev.off()
```

## net

```{r}
load("~/Documents/R/QT/analysis/1.Metatbl/metatbl.rda")
load("~/Documents/R/QT/analysis/2.Omics_data/tax_ind_m.rda")
metatbl_ind_m=metatbl_ind
#如果只看持续采集的6人：MT3  MT7  MT8  MT11 MT13 MT24
filter(metatbl_ind_m,Time=="A")%>%pull(MT)->long_MT
metatbl_ind_m_long=metatbl_ind_m[which(metatbl_ind_m$MT%in%long_MT),]
spe_acpm_ind_m_long=spe_acpm_ind_m[,which(metatbl_ind_m$MT%in%long_MT)]%>%filter(rowSums(.)>0)

#过滤掉存在样本小于2的物种
totu=t(spe_acpm_ind_m_long[,rownames(metatbl_ind_m_long)]%>%guolv(., sum=0,exist = 1))
dim(totu)

corr=c_net_calculate(totu,method = "spearman",
                     filename = "~/Documents/R/QT/analysis/5.Network/1.ind_m_long",p.adjust.method = "fdr")

corr=read_corr("~/Documents/R/QT/analysis/5.Network/1.ind_m_long")

c_net_build(corr,r_threshold = 0.6,p_threshold = 0.05,use_p_adj = T)->net_ind_m
c_net_set(net_ind_m,read_taxonomy_ind_m,
          data.frame("Abundance"=colSums(totu)),
          vertex_class="Kingdom",vertex_size="Abundance")->net_ind_m
V(net_ind_m)$color=tidai(V(net_ind_m)$color,c("#91D1C2","#8c510a","#fdbf6f","#3E4A89FF"))
c_net_plot(net_ind_m,legend_number = T)

#导到gephi调一下布局
c_net_save(net_ind_m,filename ="4.net_ind_m_long",format = "graphml")

ind_m_gephi=input_gephi("~/Documents/R/QT/analysis/5.Network/1.net_ind_m_long_gephi.graphml")

c_net_plot(net_ind_m,coors = ind_m_gephi$coors,labels_num = 0,legend_number = T,
           group_legend_title = "Kingdom",vertex.frame.width=0.5,
           # vertex.color=c("#91D1C2","#8c510a","#fdbf6f","#3E4A89FF"),
           vertex.size=mmscale(V(net_ind_m)$size,3,7),
           edge.width=mmscale(E(net_ind_m)$width,0.2,0.6),
           edge.color=c("positive"="#7876B1","negative"="red"))
```

## enrichment

```{r}
library(ReporterScore)

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
load("~/Documents/R/QT/analysis/zn_enrich/exposomeBiological_trans_cor0.5.RData")
#transtogene <- read.csv("/Users/huangzinuo/Documents/QTexposome/batch1data/RNA_seq/04.homo_sapiens.GRCh38/transcripts_to_genes.csv")

gene <- unique(edge_data.biological$to) #
gene.df <- bitr(gene, fromType = "SYMBOL",  toType = c("ENSEMBL", "ENTREZID"), OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# GO
eG <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(gene = gene.df$ENTREZID,
                          OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                          #universe = universe.df$ENTREZID,
                          qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                          ont="ALL",
                          #pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                          readable=T)
head(eG,10)
#eG.r0.6.universe <- summary(eG)
eGbio.r0.5 <-summary(eG)

# KEGG no result
eK <- enrichKEGG(gene = gene.df$ENTREZID  ,qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
head(eK,10)
eKbio.r0.5 <- summary(eK)

eKbio.r0.5$ONTOLOGY <- NA
eKbio.r0.5 <- eKbio.r0.5[,colnames(eGbio.r0.5)]
eKbio.r0.5$method <- "KEGG"
eGbio.r0.5$method <- "GO"
eGbio.r0.5$method <- eGbio.r0.5$method %>% paste(.,eGbio.r0.5$ONTOLOGY,sep = " (") %>% paste0(.,")")

eKbio.r0.5 <- ENTREZID_to_SYMBOL(eKbio.r0.5)

data.KEGG <- eKbio.r0.5#[1:10,]
data.GO <- eGbio.r0.5#[1:10,]
data <- rbind(data.GO,data.KEGG)

data$log10FDR <- -log10(data$p.adjust)
data$Description <- factor(data$Description,levels = (data$Description))
# plot lollipop cahrt
enrichbio.r0.5 <- data
  
data <- data %>% filter(ONTOLOGY !="CC" | is.na(ONTOLOGY))

save(eKbio.r0.5,eGbio.r0.5,enrichbio.r0.5,
     file="/Users/huangzinuo/Documents/QTexposome/batch1data/multiomics/R1.cor_analysis/Plot/3.biological_trans/r0.5/enrichment_result.RData")
```
